weaknesses: The abstract does not clearly articulate the significance of the Polyak-Łojasiewicz condition, which is central to the long-time convergence results.
Numerical experiments lack sufficient detail on the experimental setup, making it difficult to assess reproducibility and robustness of results.
The paper does not sufficiently address potential limitations of the proposed approach, particularly regarding the assumptions made about the activation functions.
strengths: The paper provides a solid mathematical foundation linking deep residual networks to neural ODEs, enhancing theoretical understanding.
The results are rigorously proven, with clear implications for the implicit regularization properties of gradient descent in deep learning.
The numerical experiments effectively illustrate the theoretical findings, demonstrating convergence behavior in practical scenarios.
